args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) failed health checks with an elevated error rate (~18%). Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate reduced to ~0.2%. Note: v2.3.1 also failed in staging prior to production rollout; recommend investigating the release and re-running staging validation before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api outage: v2.3.1 failed health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 across all production regions. Verified: all regions now on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and verification results. On-call has been paged.

One recommendation captured in the incident: v2.3.1 was already unhealthy in staging before it hit production, so the release should be investigated and re-validated in staging before attempting another rollout.
